sections.title: Overview
sections.body: Capacity Management helps Cost Center Owners manage team utilization and respond to resource requests. It has two main tabs: My Team (your cost center's heatmap) and Organization Overview (cross-CC comparison). A Request Management sub-view handles incoming resource and external cost requests.

sections.title: My Team Tab
sections.body: Shows your cost center's utilization as a heatmap grid. Rows are people grouped by role, columns are months. Each cell is color-coded by utilization percentage. A summary bar at the top shows team-level metrics: average utilization, headcount, over/under-allocated count.

sections.title: Heatmap Colors
sections.body: **Blue** (below 70%): Under-utilized — person has available capacity. **Green** (70-90%): Healthy utilization range. **Amber** (90-100%): Near capacity — limited availability. **Red** (above 100%): Over-allocated — needs immediate attention. Cell backgrounds use reduced opacity with the color as accent.

sections.title: Person Detail Drawer
sections.body: Click any person row or cell to open a bottom drawer showing their full allocation breakdown: which projects they're assigned to, hours per month, confirmed vs pending allocations, and utilization trend over time.

sections.title: Project Confirmation Banner
sections.body: When projects are submitted and awaiting resource confirmation, a banner appears at the top of the My Team tab showing pending projects. Each project card shows the name, organizational entity, project lead, timeline, and number of resource requests. Click **Review & Assign Resources** to open the dedicated assignment page, or **Decline** to send the project back to the Project Lead with a reason.

sections.title: Resource Assignment Grid
sections.body: The dedicated assignment page shows a tabular grid for all internal resource requests. Rows represent requested roles (e.g., Senior Developer, QA / Test Engineer), columns represent months with collapsible year headers. Click any cell to open a person dropdown and assign an employee for that specific month. Assigned cells turn green with the person's abbreviated name; unassigned cells appear in amber. A Status column on the right shows how many months are assigned per role (e.g., 12/19).

sections.title: Assign All Column
sections.body: The **All** column (between the role name and the month columns) lets you assign one person to every month of a role in a single click. Click the All cell, select an employee from the dropdown, and all months fill instantly. When all months have the same person, the All cell shows their name in blue. You can still override individual months by clicking specific cells. External cost requests are not shown on this page since they do not require employee assignment.

sections.title: Person Dropdown
sections.body: When selecting an employee, the dropdown groups people by relevance: **Matching Role** employees appear first (those whose role matches the requested role), followed by **Other Roles**. For individual month cells, each person shows their utilization percentage for that specific month, color-coded: green (below 70%), amber (70-90%), or red (above 90%). Only one employee per month per request is allowed.

sections.title: Confirming Resources
sections.body: Once all resource requests for a project have complete assignments (all months covered), the **Confirm All & Send to Controller** button becomes active. Clicking it confirms all requests, creates allocation records for each assigned employee, and moves the project to the controller's intake queue for final approval. The assigned employee names will be visible to the controller in the intake detail view.

sections.title: Request Management
sections.body: The Request Management sub-view shows incoming resource and external cost requests directed at your cost center. Requests are grouped by forecast cycle. Each request shows the project, requested role/cost type, hours or amount, period, and priority.

sections.title: Response Actions
sections.body:
For each request, you can: **Confirm** (accept as-is, assigning a named person for resource requests), **Partially Fulfill** (adjust hours, amount, or period), **Counter-Propose** (offer an alternative such as a different person or role), or **Decline** (with required reason). The Assignment Preview shows candidate people with their current utilization to help you choose.

**Delta-Based Resource Requests:** Resource requests from CRs show the change delta rather than absolute hours. Each request displays: the change direction (Increase or Decrease badge), the delta hours (e.g. +15h or -20h), the original allocation before the change, the resulting total after the change, and who is currently allocated to that role. For increases, confirming adds hours to the person's allocation. For decreases, confirming reduces the existing person's allocation.

**CR-Linked Requests:** Some resource requests are linked to change requests. When you confirm a CR-linked request, the associated CR is automatically approved and the forecast is updated. If you decline, the CR is sent back to the Project Lead. This is the final stage of the CR workflow — the CC Owner confirmation completes the approval process.

sections.title: Organization Overview Tab
sections.body: Shows utilization across all cost centers in a single heatmap. Supports three pivot dimensions: by top-level entity (e.g., Line of Business), by Role, and by Cost Center. Click any cell or row to open a bottom drawer showing project-level consumption detail for that dimension.
